'''Lycandis''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that, along with [[blartree blossom]], gave off a sweet scent at the [[Walking Garden]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Visitors enjoying the [[Garden/Legends|garden's]] lycandis was one of life's luxuries that [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] saw the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] continuing even as their world plunged into [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|war]] between the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]]<ref name="Apocalypse" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'' in [[44 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lycandis appeared in the [[2012]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]] as the finale to the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
